properties.name: The reachability gate reads tools not names; add_requirement takes kind and add_verification takes location
properties.rationale: flo2 F19 asked for an audit; the audit existed and was miscalibrated. Anthony 2026-09-20 promoted the fix and said to start with it, because it is the only item that was asserting something false.
properties.summary: vocabulary_reach.py: EDGE_ONLY and POLYMORPHIC categories, the Unplaceable refusal, no flat fallback in either branch, five tools placed and two mappings widened; baseline gained 8 classifications and lost 2 to real parameters; service.rs/enum_schema.rs/capture.rs/assure.rs: `kind` on add_requirement and `location` on add_verification; 26 test literals updated; test_vocabulary_reach.py gained four cases; CHANGELOG.
